run_batch: run a vLLM batch processing job that reads JSONL input and writes JSONL output via OpenAI-compatible endpoints
build_endpoint_registry: build an endpoint registry mapping OpenAI-compatible API paths to their async handler functions
create_chat_completion_batch: create batch chat completion requests using BatchRequestInput with file_url for audio transcription or translation
download_bytes_from_url: download audio data from HTTP/HTTPS URLs or decode base64 data URLs for batch transcription and translation
make_transcription_wrapper: make a wrapper function that converts batch transcription or translation requests into regular request objects
